note: Wall-clock budgets for tests/e2e/perf.spec.ts (npm run test:perf). Human-set ceilings, not measurements — raise one only when you have decided the new cost is worth it, and say why in the commit. `measured` is refreshed by STEM_PERF_UPDATE=1 and is context only; nothing asserts on it.

plain.prompt: Reply with exactly the single word PONG in uppercase and nothing else.

web-search.prompt: Search the web and tell me in one sentence what the current stable version of Node.js is.

measured.note: Reference points from turn_timings on the author's machine, medians over web-search turns. Native provider-side search (<=2026-07-28): total 39.6s, tool 13.2s avg. Sequential pi-web-access (2026-07-29..08-02, the regression): total 99.8s, tool 127.1s avg.
